rawCommits.subject: Raise remote-agent turn and cold-open timeouts
rawCommits.body:
Long but actively-progressing remote agent turns were tripping the sliding-idle turn_timeout (180s) and the hard 60s cold-open cap, surfacing as spurious stalls/502s when waking a hibernated microVM or running long tool/LLM work.

Raise DEFAULT_MAX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS 180->600 and DEFAULT_FIRST_EVENT_TIMEOUT_SECS 180->300, and make the cold-open cap configurable (AURA_COLD_OPEN_TIMEOUT_SECS, default 180) instead of a hardcoded 60s.

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): stop full-transcript re-render on every keystroke
rawCommits.body:
The error agent/device context hook returned a fresh object literal each render. Threaded through ChatSurface into every React.memo'd MessageBubble, this defeated memoization so the whole transcript re-parsed markdown on every draft keystroke and streaming token, causing the recent app-wide messaging slowdown.

- Memoize useErrorReportAgentInfo on its resolved primitive fields so the reference is stable across keystrokes.

- Memoize ChatMessageList and stabilize the emptyState prop so draft input changes no longer re-run the transcript map.

- Honor OS prefers-reduced-motion for the always-on attach-button halo/spin animations on every authenticated chat.

- Restore the existing formatter tests and add memoization regression tests.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: stop full-transcript re-render on every keystroke

rawCommits.subject: perf(agents): cut idle GPU cost of the 3D profile card
rawCommits.body:
The agent profile card ran a full THREE.js + UnrealBloom composite every frame for the entire time it was mounted, pausing only when the whole tab was backgrounded. On integrated GPUs and high-DPI displays this sustained GPU load could throttle the system and make the rest of the app feel slow.

- Drop antialias on the renderer: it allocated a multisampled framebuffer that the EffectComposer bypasses, for zero visual gain.

- Halt the render loop under prefers-reduced-motion once hover/flip transitions settle (idle is fully static there), instead of compositing bloom every frame.

- Re-add an off-screen pause via IntersectionObserver, guarding the spurious 0x0 first-callback that previously could freeze a visible card; resume respects both tab visibility and on-screen state.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: perf(agents): cut idle GPU cost of the 3D profile card

rawCommits.subject: fix(analytics): keep app_version on server session_active
rawCommits.body: Server-emitted session_active is deduped to the first authenticated request per user per UTC day. A header-less request (native WebSocket / ticket redeem, or the synthetic capture-demo-user) could win that slot and land the day's event on Mixpanel's app_version = "(not set)" slice. - Remember the latest non-empty X-App-Version / X-App-Platform per user and fall back to it when the triggering request omits the headers, so the daily session_active always carries a real version. - Skip session_active entirely for capture-mode tokens, which otherwise add a fake DAU user with no version. rawCommits.subject: fix(marketing): stop WebGL page background flickering on resize
rawCommits.body:
The full-screen ScreenOrbBackground / FlowFieldBackground reallocated and
cleared the WebGL drawing buffer inside a ResizeObserver but only repainted
when the rAF loop was stopped (`if (!raf) renderFrame()`). Since raf is
always active while animating, the cleared (black) buffer got composited for
a frame before the next tick redrew it, producing a flicker on every resize
step. Repaint synchronously after each resize so the cleared buffer is never
shown.

rawCommits.subject: fix(titlebar): keep window draggable beside the centered nav
rawCommits.body:
The public top nav was centered with `left: 50%` + `translateX(-50%)`.
Chromium/WebView2 compute `-webkit-app-region` draggable regions from
the untransformed layout box and ignore CSS transforms, so the nav's
no-drag rect was offset from where it renders. Blink also skips
recomputing the region on some resizes, so after a mobile->desktop
layout swap the stale hole parked beside the menu, creating a dead
zone where window dragging silently failed.

Center the slot transform-free (full-width box + `justify-content:
center`) so the layout box matches the visual position and resizing
re-centers via real layout. Visually identical across all
`.titlebar-center` consumers.

rawCommits.subject: fix(analytics): bake Mixpanel token into desktop release frontend
rawCommits.body:
The June 4-5 desktop release CI refactor split the frontend build into a
standalone `build-interface` job and routed the shipped dist through it via
the prebuilt-frontend path. That job never received VITE_MIXPANEL_TOKEN
(it lived on the old `build-app`/`package` job, which no longer builds the
frontend), so every desktop + stable build since shipped a client whose
Mixpanel SDK silently no-ops. True DAU and Engaged DAU collapsed and the
desktop app_version slice fell back to the package.json "0.0.0".

- Inject VITE_MIXPANEL_TOKEN into the `build-interface` build step in both
  release-nightly and release-stable so the token is baked into the bundle.
- Drop the now-inert VITE_MIXPANEL_TOKEN from the `package` job env.
- Add a `--require-analytics` guardrail to desktop-frontend-assets-validate
  that fails the build if the token is not inlined or app_version is the
  "0.0.0" fallback, preventing a silent regression.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: bake Mixpanel token into desktop release frontend

rawCommits.subject: fix(analytics): real app_version for web build + warn on missing server token
rawCommits.body:
Closes the remaining "0.0.0" version gap and makes a missing server-side
analytics token loud instead of silent.

- vite.config.ts: when APP_VERSION is not provided (e.g. the Render web
  build, whose build command omits it), derive the version from
  `git describe --tags --always --dirty`, then a commit-stamped fallback,
  instead of defaulting to the package.json "0.0.0". Dev builds keep the
  "0.0.0" placeholder.
- aura-os-server: log a loud startup warning when MIXPANEL_TOKEN is unset
  (server-side session_active True DAU backstop + share events disabled),
  and an info line when enabled.
- docs/render-deployment.md: document MIXPANEL_TOKEN / VITE_MIXPANEL_TOKEN
  and stamp APP_VERSION (RENDER_GIT_COMMIT) into the web build command.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: real app_version for web build + warn on missing server token

rawCommits.subject: fix(analytics): stamp is_authenticated on server-emitted session_active
rawCommits.body:
Server-side session_active only fires from require_verified_session, so the
user is authenticated by construction — but the event never carried the
is_authenticated super-property the client SDK sets. That split True DAU's
is_authenticated breakdown into a misleading false/"(not set)" bucket for
every server-emitted (backstop) user, so filtering True DAU on
is_authenticated=true silently dropped them and undercounted.

- Extract build_session_active_properties() and always stamp
  is_authenticated=true (alongside app_version/platform/ip/$os).
- Add unit tests covering the authenticated stamp with and without client
  metadata.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: stamp is_authenticated on server-emitted session_active

rendered.title: Agent onboarding wizard, mobile public site, and the new feature health page
rendered.intro: A heavy day across the marketing surface and public product story: a new black-glass agent onboarding wizard, a from-scratch mobile public site, full localization of the marketing UI, real Terms and Privacy pages, an expanded /os whitepaper, and a brand-new feature health status page wired to scheduled probes. Behind the scenes, chat rendering and the agent profile card got significantly faster, remote agent turns no longer time out spuriously, and analytics finally report a real app_version and authenticated DAU.

entries.title: Theme-aware mode selector capsule
entries.summary: The input bar's mode selector now follows the active theme accent and ships with deterministic eval fixtures.

items.text: Reworked the mode selector capsule to pull from the theme accent and softened the selected-state glow, so the selected mode label and capsule respect custom themes.
Stabilized project eval fixtures by seeding the Run sidekick tab and mocking transient remote-state probes so CI assertions stop flaking.

entries.title: Remote agent turns survive long tool and cold-start work
entries.summary: Lifted the sliding-idle and cold-open caps that were turning long-but-progressing remote turns into spurious stalls and 502s.

items.text: Raised the default idle turn timeout from 180s to 600s and the first-event timeout from 180s to 300s, and made the microVM cold-open cap configurable via AURA_COLD_OPEN_TIMEOUT_SECS (default 180s instead of a hardcoded 60s), so waking a hibernated VM or running a long LLM/tool turn no longer aborts mid-flight.

entries.title: Chat transcript and 3D profile card stop burning frames
entries.summary: Two targeted performance fixes addressed the app-wide messaging slowdown and the idle GPU cost of the agent profile card.

items.text: Fixed the full-transcript re-render that fired on every keystroke and streaming token by memoizing the error-report agent info hook and stabilizing ChatMessageList's empty-state prop, restoring smooth typing in long chats. Also honors prefers-reduced-motion for the attach-button halo.

Cut idle GPU load on the 3D agent profile card by dropping unused antialiasing, halting the render loop under reduced motion once transitions settle, and pausing off-screen via IntersectionObserver — so integrated GPUs and high-DPI displays no longer throttle the rest of the app.

entries.title: session_active keeps a real app_version
entries.summary: Closed a gap where the daily server-side session_active event could land on an empty app_version slice in Mixpanel.

items.text: Remember the latest non-empty X-App-Version / X-App-Platform per user and fall back to it when a header-less request (native WebSocket or ticket redeem) wins the day's session_active slot, and skip the event entirely for capture-mode tokens so they no longer add a fake DAU user with no version.

entries.title: Whitepaper, legal pages, and the marketing UI go fully localized
entries.summary: The public marketing surface got its biggest content drop in a while: a restructured /os whitepaper, an Always-on trust card, remembered login emails, and translations for every supported locale.

items.text: Restructured the /os AURA OS whitepaper around per-section summaries, Overview bullets, ASCII architecture diagrams, a new Invariants section, internals diagrams, and user-flow sequence diagrams, with inline code tokens linking out to the cypher-asi/aura-harness repo. Dev now reads the whitepaper from prod so /os shows real content locally.

Translated the public marketing and publicChat surfaces into all 19 non-English locales (Arabic through Traditional Chinese), routed the rotating tagline through i18n, and added reproducible translate/validate scripts so the site language now actually changes the marketing content.
Login now remembers previously-used emails as a dropdown of up to five accounts (most-recent first) with an Add-an-account option and per-account forget, replacing the single-field email input.

Made the Built-for-trust 'Always on.' toggle a clickable, sequenced switch, recentered the trust display panel against the WebGL device, killed the WebGL background flicker on resize, and unfroze the trust disc, verified cubes, and paint gallery under reduced motion.

entries.title: Agent onboarding wizard, mobile public site, and an Aura status page
entries.summary: The afternoon shipped three big public-facing threads — a six-step agent onboarding wizard, a from-scratch mobile public site, and a feature health status page — alongside whitepaper expansion to all core repos and a long tail of analytics and reliability fixes.

items.text: Shipped the new public 'Create your agent' onboarding wizard: a six-stage flow (Identity, Skills, Integrations, Messaging, Automations, Launch) built around a reusable black-glass modal, compact selectable tiles with hover/tap-revealed descriptions, a six-step stepper, curated personas/skills/integrations, and a footer Create-account CTA that applies the draft to a remote-only CEO agent after signup. Opens from the Create-agent CTA and is mounted globally.

Rebuilt the mobile public site: a Creator-pinned landing hero with the live WebGL plasma and persona character video, a full-screen hamburger menu that mirrors the desktop nav, a framed shell that matches the desktop chrome, static WebGL posters where canvases are disabled, a side-scrolling mobile changelog, and dozens of mobile-only reflow fixes for marketing sections (skill keypad, trust rail, model picker, terminal feed). The inline composer moved to /chat.

Launched the Aura feature health status page: a new /status view backed by a scheduled aura-observability GitHub workflow that runs every 30 minutes, hits a single observability route plus desktop release probes, and publishes a public status.json snapshot. Includes hardened probe shape, split-then-merged public/desktop lanes, and consistent AURA brand casing.

Added real Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages for CYPHER, INC. via a shared LegalDocument component, machine-translated into all 20 locales, and folded them into the standard marketing page composition (hero, body, ChangelogPreview, CTA, footer). The black-shell color convention now extends to /terms, /privacy, and /docs.

Extended the /os whitepaper beyond AURA Harness to aura-os, aura-router, aura-network, aura-storage, and z-billing, each with its own collapsible nav group and repo-aware code-reference links. The sidebar now stays pinned while reading, the empty-state flash is gone, and /docs and /os share a single MarkdownDocSite layout with an 'On this page' TOC, both pinned to prod content in dev.

Restored analytics integrity end-to-end: re-injected VITE_MIXPANEL_TOKEN into the desktop build-interface step (it had silently dropped out in the June 4–5 CI refactor, leaving the SDK no-op since), added a --require-analytics guardrail that fails the build if the token isn't baked in or app_version is the '0.0.0' fallback, derived a real app_version from git describe for the Render web build, logged a loud server warning when MIXPANEL_TOKEN is unset, and stamped is_authenticated=true on server-emitted session_active so True DAU breakdowns stop dropping backstop users.

Hardened the standalone Agents experience: auto-select a valid agent on login by clearing the cached lastAgentId for logged-out or deleted agents, warm chat history on click and post-login redirect to skip the cold-load gate, hide local (machine_type="local") agents from every web/mobile surface (sidebar, project picker, agent switcher, menu cycling) since they need the desktop bridge, link the deployed harness commit from the env popup, and drop the dead host-settings button from the web titlebar.

Disabled Vite 8's auto console forwarding in dev to prevent an infinite error loop that locked the page before React mounted, and fixed a titlebar drag dead zone caused by transform-based centering of the public nav by switching to a transform-free centered slot.

highlights: Mobile public site with framed shell and WebGL landing
Public marketing UI translated into 19 locales
Terms, Privacy, and an /os whitepaper for all core repos
Aura feature health status page wired to scheduled probes
Faster chat transcript rendering and lighter agent profile card
Analytics: real app_version and authenticated session_active restored
Remote agent turns no longer trip spurious 180s/60s timeouts
